title: Implement operator ed25519 signing on POST articles
description:
After header validation and dedup check, compute canonical bytes of the article using core::canonical_bytes(), sign with the operator's ed25519 key loaded from config. Attach the base64url-encoded signature as a X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig: header. The signing key is loaded once at startup and held in a SecretKey type; never logged. Artifact: reader/src/post/sign.rs.

Acceptance:
- Signature is valid as verified by core::signing::verify()
- Signing key is loaded from PEM file specified in config; startup fails with clear error if missing
- Key material does not appear in any log line (unit test asserts log output)
- X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig: header is appended to article before storage
